title: Ruby
notes: Parser, scanner, private headers and bundled queries use the pinned upstream revision, with listed local adaptations. Existing public API and useful indentation configuration retained.
Native fixtures check syntax, captures and supported predicates; they do not certify all syntax, incremental editing or Swift theme rendering.
source:
# Endless methods, interpolation and heredocs
class Example
  LIMIT = 42
  def compute(value) = "hello #{value}"
  def message
    <<~TEXT
hello
TEXT
  end
end
example = Example.new
example.compute(1)
query_adaptations: Use upstream C scanner (replacing old C++ scanner); pinned revision contains the heredoc serialization bounds fix. Sanitizer regression covers near-limit/oversized delimiter states and roundtrip.
Omit local-dependent catch-all identifier/function/reference patterns; structural method captures remain. Bare ambiguous identifiers use normal variable styling.
Map escape to string.escape and embedded interpolation to none; drop tag documentation transformations while preserving raw docs/tags.
